commands.name: CreateLocalTask
input: optional reviewed initial SR/RFC/Device Reference link selections
steps: validate bounded name and optional complete positive-duration schedule; convert local schedule via OBJECTIVE_TIMEZONE_V1 before writer lock
inside UoW revalidate selected LLD-03 identities and active relationship eligibility
allocate task_id
insert receipt then Local Task
when schedule supplied append task_plan_revision and current pointer
insert selected Task-owned relationships
audit minimal creation/relationship/plan refs and commit
after commit request grouping recompute for any schedulable future noncancelled Task
rules: no Objective is silently created/joined by this mutation; grouping remains a separately reviewed proposal

commands.name: RegisterManualWfmTask
steps: validate TK+14 and optional schedule
inside UoW classify task_no using WfmTaskRepository.task_no_status and load exact RFC/current lifecycle
if RETIRED return WFM_TASK_NO_RETIRED before receipt/domain mutation
if ACTIVE under the same RFC return semantic NO_CHANGE/adoption target; differing current parent requires ReassignWfmParent review
if ABSENT require active WFM RFC eligibility, allocate task_id, insert receipt, Task(kind=wfm), WFM identity and initial RFC assignment event
optional operational plan is manual evidence only and never provider source plan
audit and commit
request grouping recompute when eligible
rules: if RFC does not exist, the enclosing UI flow first uses LLD-03 CreateOrAdoptRfcIdentity to create the provisional RFC; an orphan provisional RFC after later WFM failure is valid and never silently deleted
exact later source Task No. adopts an ACTIVE manual task in place
a RETIRED Task No. is permanent nonreuse authority and can never be manually registered or source-adopted again

commands.name: ReassignWfmParent
steps: load WFM/current and candidate RFC
classify history risk from plan/source/objective/execution/retry/outcome
require explicit high-risk review when protected operational history exists
revalidate new RFC active eligibility
insert receipt
update current_rfc_id/assignment_revision and append assignment event
recompute derived root/SR context only; preserve Task identity/Objectives/source history
audit and commit
rules: does not create WFM hierarchy flags
source-owned parent conflict may enter through LLD-04 review but uses same service semantics

commands.name: SetTaskPlan
steps: validate/convert complete positive interval outside lock
inside UoW load Task, current execution/source-terminal/explicit lock state and reject effective ordinary plan lock
if semantically same UTC interval+context use NO_CHANGE
insert receipt
append immutable plan revision and update task_plan_current
if Task currently belongs to Objective do not change membership pin; rebuild aggregate attention so plan-membership mismatch is explicit
audit and commit
request grouping recompute
rules: accepted current Task plan and Objective membership-plan pin may temporarily differ without creating overlapping accepted Objectives

commands.name: CorrectTaskPlan
input: high-risk review when execution/terminal history exists
steps: validate replacement interval/timezone
inside UoW load exact Task plan/execution/history
require correction authority when ordinary plan lock exists
insert receipt
append correction plan revision targeting predecessor and make it current
never rewrite historical Objective membership pins; planned/current memberships require separate regroup while terminal/historical memberships remain frozen
audit prior/new plan refs and commit
rules: completed reports remain outside this mutation

commands.name: SetExplicitTaskLock
steps: inside UoW load current derived lock context
reject unlock as ineffective when execution/source-terminal/protected history independently locks the dimension
insert receipt
append lock event/update explicit lock projection
audit and commit
commands.rule: explicit lock is history; current time never changes it automatically

commands.name: ChangeTaskRelationship
steps: inside UoW load Task and exact target
reject direct SR/RFC relationship on WFM; WFM SR/RFC context derives through owning RFC
Device Reference valid for either Task kind
if requested current state already holds use semantic NO_CHANGE
insert receipt then append/open or close relationship state preserving prior row
audit and commit
rules: Objective context recalculates only as derived view
regularized Device remains same Device Reference relationship

commands.name: ReviewWfmActivityRelationship
steps: load all exact distinct TK identities and current intervals/source/lifecycle state
insert receipt

distinct_activity records separate/no shared lineage; same_activity assigns reviewed shared lineage; retry_lineage additionally requires legal immediate predecessor/successor relation; unresolved_source_error preserves identities and conflict warning
recompute competing-attempt conflict projection from shared lineage + overlapping active intervals
audit decision and commit
rules: overlapping active attempts in one reviewed lineage remain a blocking conflict until reviewed resolution changes lifecycle/lineage
never collapse Task identities or create overlapping Objectives to evade conflict

commands.name: CreateLocalTaskRetry
input: new task name or inherited reviewed name
steps: require predecessor has no direct successor and validate new schedule
outside lock preview selected owned relationships and optional LLD-07 participant impact
inside UoW revalidate predecessor/successor eligibility and selected relationship states
allocate new task_id
insert receipt, new Local Task, retry relation, retry-clone plan revision and selected Task-owned links
when Inventory selections supplied call LLD-07 participant in same UoW; unavailable/indeterminate fails closed
audit new attempt/predecessor refs and commit
request normal grouping recompute
rules: new Task enters Objective only through normal reviewed grouping

commands.name: LinkWfmRetryAttempt
steps: inside UoW prove both are distinct WFM identities, predecessor has no successor and successor has no predecessor
insert receipt/retry relation
assign/reconcile reviewed activity lineage
recompute competing-attempt conflict
audit and commit
commands.rule: new provider attempt must already possess its distinct canonical TK identity; this command never fabricates one
